stories.title: US orders federal agencies to remove China’s DeepSeek AI from their systems
stories.dek: The U.S. has ordered federal civilian agencies to remove DeepSeek products and third-party services built using its technology, citing national security concerns.

stories.title: OpenAI says an AI agent lied about disabling its safety monitoring system
stories.dek: OpenAI disclosed a pair of safety incidents that involved AI agents weakening their safety monitoring systems during internal coding tasks.

stories.title: A Design Flaw in Share Links Exposes Users’ Personal Conversations With Meta’s Muse
stories.dek: The company is suspending the feature after security researchers discovered how easy it was to access sensitive information shared with the AI assistant.

stories.title: Judge dismisses Sam Altman’s sister’s sexual abuse lawsuit
stories.dek: On Tuesday, US District Judge Zachary Bluestone dismissed the lawsuit Ann Altman filed last year alleging that her brother, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, had sexually abused her throughout her childhood.

stories.title: ChatGPT ganha pasta protegida por senha e biometria para esconder segredos
stories.dek: A OpenAI anunciou o lançamento de chats bloqueados no ChatGPT .

stories.title: Anthropic registra prejuízo líquido de mais de US$ 80 bi no primeiro semestre, diz agência
stories.dek: O prejuízo líquido da Anthropic aumentou drasticamente para US$ 80,7 bilhões (R$ 404,63 bilhões) no primeiro semestre deste ano, em grande parte devido a um aumento no valor justo dos títulos conversí

stories.title: Europe Wants Data Centers. Its Climate Goals Are Getting in the Way
stories.dek: A plan to funnel the heat given off by data centers into nearby homes has run aground in Germany.

stories.title: OpenEvidence: a IA de US$ 15 bilhões que ganha espaço nos consultórios dos EUA
stories.dek: Empresa afirma alcançar 65% dos médicos americanos e avança nos hospitais, enquanto pesquisas discutem limites das respostas e da avaliação clínica

stories.title: Spotify faz faxina e apaga mais de 75 milhões de músicas falsas feitas por IA
stories.dek: O Spotify anunciou a remoção de mais de 75 milhões de faixas de sua plataforma por violações graves ou repetidas das regras contra spam.

stories.title: AI Guardrails Aren’t Stopping Criminal Hackers
stories.dek: Hackers around the world are all-in on using agentic AI to wage attacks—and manipulating tools like Anthropic’s Claude to help them carry out their crimes.

stories.title: AI promises productivity, but for managers, it’s mostly a headache for now
stories.dek: More than 50% of managers say they're finding it harder to evaluate employees' work after adopting AI, according to a new survey.

stories.title: Google’s more personalized Gemini AI is heading to your car
stories.dek: Google is bringing Personal Intelligence to Gemini AI in your car.
